### Responsio.
192. Lord Primarius, you have thus sprayed the red of slander because of the shoemaker, so that many a person recoils because of the slander. That is the filth that harms them in their souls, that they believe slander and take it into their hearts, and slander GOD’s gift.

### Pasquil.
193. Oh, that all those who read your writings must go away with you.

### Responsio.
194. What a Christian wish that is from a High Priest. One would hardly find it, or not at all, with Caiphas, and it would likely stand nowhere in the Bible. It will soon come to pass that his good wish will come true, that the sheep will be separated from the goats, so that the wicked might have room in hell, since they can tolerate no one around them on earth.

### Pasquil.
195. Yes, you have also infected Silesia with your teaching, where you will then be received by many, whom I know for certain. They are as much more noble than others in their station as Luther was; thus they also precede others with their novelty.…

Furthermore, this was also to the reproach and rebuke of Moses himself. For the Lord, by that means, argued against Moses for his excessive negligence, because he had not circumcised his sons, and had neglected that most holy covenant of God with his family by omitting circumcision. For we never read that the office of circumcision was once mandated by God specifically to the Priests, since circumcision was practiced for more than four hundred years before the Priests were set apart from the rest of the people, and it was instituted by God and practiced by the people.
